MERIDIAN HOLLOW — Company Fact Sheet
Overview
Meridian Hollow is a freshwater desalination startup founded in 2019 in Reykjavik, Iceland. The
company builds compact, modular purification units called "Tidepods" for remote coastal
communities. As of 2025 it employs 142 people across three offices.
The Tidepod Product Line
The flagship product, the Tidepod-3, processes up to 4,000 litres of seawater per day and runs
entirely on solar power. It weighs 38 kilograms and can be assembled by two people in under 45
minutes. The earlier Tidepod-2 model, discontinued in 2023, processed only 1,500 litres per day.
Each Tidepod-3 uses a proprietary graphene-oxide membrane rated for 5 years of continuous use
before replacement.
Pricing & Deployment

company raised a 12 million USD Series A round in 2021, led by Northwind Ventures.
Sustainability Commitments
Meridian Hollow pledged to be carbon-neutral by 2027. All Tidepod packaging is made from
recycled ocean plastic. In 2024 the company recycled 2.3 tonnes of decommissioned membranes
through a partner facility in Rotterdam.

Pricing & Deployment
A single Tidepod-3 unit costs 8,900 USD. Meridian Hollow offers a subscription maintenance plan
at 600 USD per year, which includes one free membrane replacement. The company has
deployed 1,270 units across 14 countries, with the largest deployment — 300 units — in coastal
Kenya as part of the "BlueWell" initiative launched in 2022.
Leadership
The CEO is Dr. Anneli Vos, a former marine biologist who co-founded the company. The CTO,
Rajiv Menon, previously worked on membrane technology at a Singaporean water utility. The
company raised a 12 million USD Series A round in 2021, led by Northwind Ventures.
Sustainability Commitments

MERIDIAN HOLLOW — Company Fact Sheet
Overview
Meridian Hollow is a freshwater desalination startup founded in 2019 in Reykjavik, Iceland. The
company builds compact, modular purification units called "Tidepods" for remote coastal
communities. As of 2025 it employs 142 people across three offices.
The Tidepod Product Line
The flagship product, the Tidepod-3, processes up to 4,000 litres of seawater per day and runs
entirely on solar power. It weighs 38 kilograms and can be assembled by two people in under 45
minutes. The earlier Tidepod-2 model, discontinued in 2023, processed only 1,500 litres per day.
Each Tidepod-3 uses a proprietary graphene-oxide membrane rated for 5 years of continuous use
before replacement.
Pricing & Deployment

company raised a 12 million USD Series A round in 2021, led by Northwind Ventures.
Sustainability Commitments
Meridian Hollow pledged to be carbon-neutral by 2027. All Tidepod packaging is made from
recycled ocean plastic. In 2024 the company recycled 2.3 tonnes of decommissioned membranes
through a partner facility in Rotterdam.
